_comment: AI battle arena roster. Each fighter is a provider config with a name. API keys are referenced only by environment-variable name (token_env), never stored here, so this file is safe to commit. Hosted providers are external endpoints: a battle only reaches them when run with --allow-external (or GREYNOC_DMZ_AI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=1). Supported providers: openai_compatible, anthropic, gemini. base_url is optional for anthropic and gemini (sane defaults are used).
